scope.implementedContract: AX-confirmed paragraph nodes whose direct visible children are links and br elements preserve AX child order across StaticText, link, and LineBreak children. LineBreak and punctuation-only StaticText are boundaries, not spoken stops.
guards: requires saved AX paragraph node, direct AX LineBreak child, direct AX link children matching direct DOM links in order, and focusable AX link names
skips role, aria-label, aria-labelledby, interactive ancestors, listitem ancestors, native/ARIA table ancestors, and expanded controlled regions
skips generated metadata and other direct element children by requiring visible direct elements to be only a or br
does not inspect Royal Mail selectors, copy, URLs, classes, filenames, layout, href extensions, or site-specific strings

decisions.whyGeneric: The saved HTML and AX snapshots show ordinary p elements with direct inline links and direct br children. AX exposes the same child-order contract independent of site copy.
decisions.whyNarrow: The rule is limited to AX-backed paragraph/link/br children and does not broaden existing inline link, generated metadata, listitem, table, or interactive-wrapper behavior.

engineChanges.summary: Added directAxInlineLinkBreakParagraphFragments for AX-backed p + direct a + br child-order traversal.
Added a dedicated split-direct-ax-inline-link-break-paragraph traversal source and descent guard.
Added positive tests for text-link-br-text-link and link-br-text plus negative guards for listitems, table cells, interactive wrappers, and generated metadata.
Rebuilt extension runtime from the updated engine.
